components.name: accordion
components.title: Accordion
consumerResponsibilities: Use concise trigger labels
Keep hidden content understandable when revealed
components.accessibility: Base UI manages keyboard navigation, expanded state and panel relationships.

components.name: alert
components.title: Alert

Provide actionable recovery copy when applicable
components.accessibility: Uses role=alert; reserve it for content that should be announced immediately.

components.name: alert-dialog
components.title: Alert Dialog
consumerResponsibilities: Provide a title and description

Restore focus to the trigger after close
requiredComposition: Include AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription
Provide explicit cancel and confirm actions

components.name: aspect-ratio
components.title: Aspect Ratio
consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful content and alternatives for non-text information
components.accessibility: The wrapper is presentational; provide appropriate semantics and alternative text for its content.

components.name: attachment
components.title: Attachment
consumerResponsibilities: Provide an accessible name
Choose button or link semantics from the intended action
components.accessibility: Use descriptive filenames, expose file type and size in text, and label icon-only actions.

components.name: avatar
components.title: Avatar
consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful content and alternatives for non-text information

components.name: badge
components.title: Badge
consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful content and alternatives for non-text information

components.name: bubble
components.title: Bubble
consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful content and alternatives for non-text information
components.accessibility: Keep sender and timing information available in text and preserve chronological reading order.

components.name: button
components.title: Button
consumerResponsibilities: Provide an accessible name
Choose button or link semantics from the intended action
components.accessibility: Base UI preserves native button semantics, disabled state and keyboard activation.

focusManagement: Participate in native tab order when enabled
Expose a visible focus indicator

Mark decorative icons as hidden from assistive technology

components.name: button-group
components.title: Button Group
consumerResponsibilities: Provide a group label
Keep the action order meaningful

components.name: calendar
components.title: Calendar

components.name: card
components.title: Card
consumerResponsibilities: Provide meaningful content and alternatives for non-text information
components.accessibility: Choose semantic children and headings based on the content hierarchy.

components.name: carousel
components.title: Carousel
consumerResponsibilities: Provide accessible names

components.accessibility: Name the carousel, label meaningful slides and keep previous and next controls available to keyboard users.

components.name: chart
components.title: Chart
consumerResponsibilities: Provide a concise text summary

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox

Own value, validation and submission

Expose a visible focus indicator

components.name: collapsible
components.title: Collapsible

Keep hidden content understandable when revealed

components.name: combobox
components.title: Combobox

components.name: command
components.title: Command
consumerResponsibilities: Provide accessible names
Own application data and side effects

components.name: data-table

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker

components.name: dialog
components.title: Dialog

Provide a clear close or decision path

Restore focus to the trigger after close

components.name: direction

components.name: drawer
components.title: Drawer

Provide a clear close or decision path

components.name: dropdown-menu

Provide meaningful item labels

Restore focus to the trigger after close

Keep labels meaningful for typeahead navigation

components.name: empty
components.title: Empty

Provide actionable recovery copy when applicable

components.name: input

components.name: input-otp
components.title: Input OTP
consumerResponsibilities: Compose a visible label and error description

components.name: item

components.name: kbd
components.title: Kbd

components.name: label

components.name: marker

components.name: message
components.title: Message

Provide actionable recovery copy when applicable

components.name: message-scroller

components.name: native-select

components.name: navigation-menu

components.name: pagination

components.name: popover

Restore focus to the trigger after close

Do not use for information that must remain continuously available

components.name: progress

components.name: questionnaire

components.name: radio-group

components.name: resizable

components.name: scroll-area

components.name: select
components.title: Select
consumerResponsibilities: Compose a visible label and error description
Own value, validation and submission
components.accessibility: Base UI manages trigger, popup, active option and keyboard navigation relationships.

keyboardInteractions.outcome: Close without changing the committed value

focusManagement: Keep DOM focus on the trigger while using active descendant navigation
Restore focus to the trigger after close

Place SelectItem instances inside SelectGroup

components.name: separator

components.name: sheet

components.name: slider

components.name: sonner

components.name: switch
components.title: Switch

Own value, validation and submission

focusManagement: Keep focus on the control after toggling
Expose a visible focus indicator

components.name: table

Keep each tab associated with its panel

components.name: textarea

components.name: toast

Keep essential information available outside the tooltip
